title: Autonomous Maintenance Platform — Containers (C2) · TO-BE target, org-wide

nodes.name: Control Plane
nodes.desc: Leader-elected reconciler: per-task state machines, fair share across products, rails at every level

nodes.name: Burst Runners
nodes.desc: One Job per burst (dev / reviewer / tester); warm image per product family; no k8s API, egress allowlist

nodes.name: Webhook Receiver
nodes.desc: The only public surface; verifies HMAC, dedups deliveries, emits wake events; holds no other credential

nodes.name: Console + CLI
nodes.desc: Live fleet state + streaming burst logs; task timelines, usage, violations, memory browser; actions audited (Fermata SSO)

nodes.name: Monitor
nodes.desc: Per-product watchers file structured auto issues from telemetry; rate-limited, behind the ready gate

nodes.name: Ledger
nodes.desc: Tasks, bursts, violations + products, quotas, subscriptions, audit log

nodes.name: Session Archive
nodes.desc: Task-keyed resumable transcripts, checksummed; retention policy lives here

nodes.name: Platform Memory
nodes.desc: Per-product namespaces with provenance; written only via harvest, read only via prompt assembly as auto-class data

nodes.name: Observability
nodes.desc: Collector → org backend; trace-per-burst with task correlation; agents emit, never read

nodes.name: Product Teams
nodes.desc: Own both gates (ready label; review + merge); watch their products in the console; contribute subscriptions

nodes.name: Platform Team
nodes.desc: Register products, set quotas, manage the pool, handle incidents — through the console, never SQL

nodes.name: GitHub (Fermata org)
nodes.desc: 4 org Apps: dev · reviewer · tester · monitor; per-repo-scoped tokens minted per burst

nodes.name: Product Repos ×N
nodes.desc: fermata/* repos, each with its own CI and contracts: CLAUDE.md + TESTING.md

nodes.name: Product Sandboxes
nodes.desc: Per product, declared, disposable; TEST_* creds injected into tester bursts only

nodes.name: Claude (Anthropic)
nodes.desc: Team subscription pool (not API billing): opt-in member tokens with caps, rate-limit-aware rotation

nodes.name: Secret Manager
nodes.desc: Vault / External Secrets: platform creds, pool tokens, TEST_* sets — injected at spawn, never archived

nodes.name: Slack
nodes.desc: Per-team channels: ball-is-with-you nudges + budget/violation alerts; deep links only, never actionable

nodes.name: Org Telemetry
nodes.desc: Existing org logs, metrics and Alertmanager; the monitor's input
